Title: Agent self-service password reset via email link
Preconditions: Registered agent who has forgotten password.
Test Steps:

2. Enter agent email.
3. Open the Supabase Auth reset email and follow the link.
4. Set a new password.
Expected Result: A clickable 'Forgot password' link opens a form to enter an email; submitting sends a Supabase reset email (generic confirmation, no account enumeration; in dev it lands in Mailpit :54324). The emailed link opens a 'set new password' page. After setting the password the recovery session is signed out and the user is redirected to the login page with a 'Password updated' confirmation, then signs in with the new password. Actual Result: RETEST after fix. Login page now has a working 'Forgot your password?' link -> /auth/forgot-password. Login then succeeds with the new password. Fully self-service, no staff intervention.

Post-reset UX improved during retest at Lucia's request: reset now signs out and redirects to login with a confirmation (edit in app/auth/actions.ts resetPassword + app/auth/login/page.tsx) instead of auto-entering the portal.
